title: stachys aspera var. hispidula
intro: Stachys aspera var. hispidula, commonly known as Wood Betony or Rough Betony, is a plant species in the mint family that is native to Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving digestive issues due to its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in soothing muscle cramps, reducing fever, and treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Stachys aspera var. hispidula include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
